column1: # The 5,000 most frequent lemmas of classical Latin in the LASLA corpus (1,751,379 words, 17,932 lemmas), made by scripts/latin_frequency.py.

# Derived from the LASLA corpus (Laboratoire d'Analyse Statistique des Langues Anciennes, Université de Liège) as linked to the LiLa Lemma Bank and published by the LiLa project (CIRCSE, Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore), https://github.com/CIRCSE/LASLA. Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
# rank, lemma (as the corpus spells it: u for u and v, i for i and j), count, part of speech, class (LASLA: A noun,
# B verb, C adjective, with the declension or conjugation; 5 is the capiō kind, 6 irregular, A7 a Greek noun), the works it
# occurs in, the LiLa lemma (http://lila-erc.eu/data/id/<this>), its commonest forms.
